items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Like Richard Payne? Did you know Richard Payne? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Rene, uh, uh, uh, uh, Kid Rene.

ctx.x: Like Richard Payne? Did you know Richard Payne? Or Joe Brooks? Or what's that Batiste call's name? Rene Batiste?
